modules.title: Bootstrap
modules.summary: Wire up your machines, make your first real commit, meet your tutor. Five small wins and the whole loop - learn, verify, commit, sync, see it rendered - is running.

modules.title: The Terminal Is a Place
modules.summary: pwd, cd, ls, paths, tab completion, and the manual. The terminal stops being a void and becomes a place you can move through.

exercises.title: Homes and Roots (Two Kinds of Path)

modules.title: Files & Folders
modules.summary: mkdir, touch, cp, mv, rm, and * patterns. The filesystem stops being scenery: you build it, rearrange it, clean it up - and tame one gloriously messy downloads folder.

modules.title: The Daily Loop
modules.summary: status, add, commit, pull, push - the five moves you'll make every day for the rest of your computing life. Practiced on toy repos first, then for real: this module ends with a commit of yours on GitHub that was never practice.

modules.title: Permissions
modules.summary: Every file carries a rulebook: who may read, write, run. Decode ls -l, speak chmod in letters and numbers, then write your first script - and meet the shebang the kernel reads.

modules.title: Pipes & Text Streams
modules.summary: > and >> aim output at files; | snaps small tools into pipelines. grep, sort, uniq, cut, wc - then you mine a real server log for its top talkers, one line, no code.

modules.title: Phase Gates
modules.summary: Cold, 10-minute self-tests that open the next phase. No hints, no tutor, free retakes forever - a gate measures what your hands remember.

modules.title: Back in the Saddle
modules.summary: Variables, f-strings, functions, if/elif, loops, lists - a brisk re-tread of the Python you once started. You spent phase 1 running programs; now you write them.

modules.title: Collections & Loops
modules.summary: Lists, dicts, and loops - closing with the A4 log boss re-solved in Python: same problem, second language.

modules.title: Environment & PATH
modules.summary: Where commands come from: environment variables, $PATH, aliases, and your shell's config files. Ends with your own bin/ on the PATH.

modules.title: Functions & Structure
modules.summary: Functions, arguments, returns, and modules - taught the way this platform grades you: make the committed tests pass. Demystifies `codin check` from the inside.

modules.title: Read Your Own Dashboard
modules.summary: Open docs/ and read the actual HTML of your own dashboard - tags, structure, where the numbers land. You'll never see a webpage the same way.

modules.title: Files, JSON & Errors
modules.summary: Read and write files, parse JSON, handle errors without fear - including pretty-printing your own events.jsonl: you'll read the platform's brain.

modules.title: Processes & Jobs
modules.summary: Programs become processes: ps, top, Ctrl+C vs Ctrl+Z, jobs, fg, kill. The operating-system drip-feed begins here.

modules.title: Branching & Merging
modules.summary: Branches, merges, and one scripted merge conflict you'll resolve on purpose - then a real feature branch merged through a GitHub pull request.

modules.title: Stdlib Superpowers
modules.summary: pathlib, subprocess (Python driving git!), http.server, argparse - and shipping the flashcards CLI, your first complete app.

modules.title: Shell Scripting
modules.summary: Loops, variables, and `set -euo pipefail`: turn the pipelines you type into scripts that run while you watch. Ports an A4 pipeline into a reusable tool.

modules.title: M1: Your First Platform Feature
modules.summary: Add one small feature to codin.py on a branch, merged through a real pull request. From here on you don't just use the platform - you build it.

modules.title: Tables & Queries
modules.summary: SQLite from day one (it's already on your machines): SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, INSERT - on data worth querying.

modules.title: CSS: Make It Yours
modules.summary: Selectors, the box model, CSS variables, dark mode - practiced by restyling your own dashboard. The scaffold left obvious hooks on purpose.

modules.title: Modeling & JOINs
modules.summary: Design tables that relate - including this platform's own schema on paper first - then JOIN them. Earns JOINed Up.

modules.title: JS Fundamentals
modules.summary: Variables, functions, arrays, objects - 'a JS object is roughly a Python dict'. Your Python carries most of the weight here.

modules.title: SQL from Python
modules.summary: sqlite3 in the stdlib: parameters, transactions, and the bridge between the two languages you now speak.

modules.title: Fetch & Render
modules.summary: fetch a JSON file, walk it, render DOM from data - the architecture-clicks module: you'll see exactly how your dashboard turns the event log into a page.

modules.title: M2: The Great Migration
modules.summary: Move the platform's local progress cache into SQLite - with a Python export step still emitting events.jsonl for the dashboard. A real ETL, on your own data.

modules.title: Aggregation & Reporting
modules.summary: GROUP BY, COUNT, AVG - run on your own progress data: XP per week, wins per device. Your history becomes your dataset.

modules.title: M3: Quiz Mode, Yours
modules.summary: The dashboard's practice page gets its next version - designed and built by you.

modules.title: History & Repair
modules.summary: git bisect hunts a planted bug, reflog resurrects 'lost' work, and you tag your platform v1.0. Nothing is ever lost.

modules.title: Objects & Testing
modules.summary: Classes when they help, unittest always - closing with a debugging dojo of planted bugs to exorcise.

modules.title: M4: Write a Badge Rule
modules.summary: Add a badge rule to docs/data/badges.json (or invent a new rule kind) - and watch it award itself retroactively from history you already lived.

modules.title: Stats Page & the SVG Tree
modules.summary: The project: a wholly-yours stats page, plus rewriting the skill tree in SVG - the upgrade the scaffold deliberately left for you.

modules.title: The Toolbelt
modules.summary: A project: build the personal command toolbelt in bin/ you'll actually use - and earn the Toolsmith badge.

modules.title: Hello, Compiler
modules.summary: cc turns text into machine code. Rewrite three tiny programs you've already written in Python - same logic, new world.

modules.title: Control Flow & the Stack
modules.summary: Types, loops, functions, and the call stack - including blowing it up on purpose to see what 'stack overflow' literally means.

modules.title: What a Kernel Is
modules.summary: The program beneath your programs: what the kernel does, what userspace is, and the Termux revelation - uname -a on the phone in your pocket.

modules.title: Pointers & Memory
modules.summary: The famous cliff, taken in the smallest possible steps: predict-before-run worksheets, valgrind as a friend, and segfaults celebrated as specimens.

modules.title: /proc Spelunking
modules.summary: The kernel narrates itself under /proc: live process anatomy, cmdlines, file descriptors. Desktop-first exploring.

modules.title: Structs & Files
modules.summary: structs, arrays of them, reading and writing files - the to-do CLI a third time, now in C.

modules.title: Memory
modules.summary: Virtual memory made touchable: read /proc/<pid>/maps of a C program you wrote - stack, heap, code, right there at their addresses.

modules.title: Syscalls
modules.summary: strace your own printf and watch it become write(). The line between your program and the kernel, made visible. (Desktop-only labs.)

modules.title: Filesystems & Inodes
modules.summary: What a file actually is: inodes, hard and soft links, mounts, and df/du - the storage layer under everything you've built.

modules.title: fork, exec, wait
modules.summary: How every program ever gets started: one process becomes two, one of them becomes something else. The shell capstone's engine room.

modules.title: Capstone: Write Your Own Shell
modules.summary: Five staged milestones - REPL, fork/exec/wait, built-ins, redirection, one pipe - ending with the ritual: use YOUR shell to run git commit on this repo.

modules.title: How Programs Become Processes
modules.summary: ldd, readelf, and strace -f on your own shell running ls - narrated end to end, in your own words. The Whole Story badge.

modules.title: M5: Author an Exercise
modules.summary: Build a Codin exercise from curriculum/_template/ - instructions, checker, quiz questions. The platform now teaches what you decide it teaches.

modules.title: Deeper Water (electives)
modules.summary: Loudly optional summits: a mini-ps in C, a TCP echo server, namespaces with unshare - and signposts to OSTEP, xv6, and Linux From Scratch for someday.

modules.title: The Explainer
modules.summary: The write-up project: 'How Linux works, as far as I can tell' - published on your dashboard with your own strace captures.

modules.title: M6: Own Your Pipeline
modules.summary: Elective: replace plain /docs publishing with a GitHub Action you wrote and understand.

modules.title: Self-Hosted
modules.summary: The bridge to your homelab: deploy this dashboard onto your own server, on your own network. The Self-Hosted badge - and the beginning of the next journey.
